shared_elements: standing human figure with raised arms
elongated linear object held or extended above figures (rayed disc/staff-like bar)
justification: Both surfaces show upright human figures with arms raised toward something above them, and both include a small disc/circle, but these are near-universal motifs rather than a shared conventional scheme. A depicts a tightly composed, naturalistically proportioned adoration group with a rayed disc, offering stand and dense columns of sign-writing filling the lower field, whereas B shows sparse, wholly schematic stick-like figures with pecked outlines scattered across the surface with no text or framing composition.
